sources.title: NYC Council Constituent Services Data release
observations: The Council described CouncilStat as an application used by many district offices to track constituent issues.
The Council said CouncilStat data would be updated daily on the NYC Open Data portal.

sources.title: City Council Constituent Services (2015 to 2025)
sources.publisher: New York City Council through NYC Open Data
observations: The metadata labels the dataset Historical data.
The dataset contains 341299 issue rows across 51 Council accounts.
The earliest open date is 2015-01-01 and the latest is 2025-01-09.

sources.title: Join Our Team: Constituent Services Liaison
observations: The official page was published on 2026-02-24 and modified on 2026-02-26.
It instructs staff to enter cases in Council Connect and calls it a Council-wide constituent service database.

sources.title: NYC Open Data catalog search for Council Connect
observations: None was a New York City Council dataset named for, or described as an export from, Council Connect.

sources.title: 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present
observations: The dataset is identified as 2020 to Present.
Its official metadata says it is updated daily and omits personally identifying customer information.

sources.title: Website provides new information about council members' focus
observations: The March 14, 2016 report documents CallNYC and Jamie Burkart's 24-hour build.

claims.statement: CallNYC is a 2016 independent project built in a 24-hour sprint from the Council's then-daily, anonymized CouncilStat release.
limitations: The evidence does not make CallNYC an official Council product or establish formal Council adoption.

claims.statement: As of 2026-08-13, official sources identify Council Connect as a current Council-wide constituent-service database, while NYC Open Data labels Council casework through early 2025 as historical and our catalog review found no current Council Connect export comparable to the daily 311 feed.
limitations: No located official source states the exact CouncilStat retirement date, the Council Connect cutover date, or why the public publishing path changed.
A dated catalog search supports a not-found finding; it does not prove that no Council Connect export exists in every possible public location.
The 311 comparison concerns publication cadence and public accessibility, not equivalence of service models or case semantics.
